methodology.policy: Every app listed here must be genuinely usable on its free tier: not a 3-day trial, not a crippled demo, not an app that took your money in year one and now demands rent. Ads may exist on a free tier if the core features still work; paywalls that block the app's core purpose do not.
methodology.verifiedFreeOn: The date we last actively checked that the free tier still behaves as described, using the apps own store listing and documentation.
methodology.recheckOn: When we plan to verify again. Cards with recheck dates in the past are marked NEEDS RECHECK on the site.
methodology.linkTests: Every link on every card is tested (HTTP status checked) by scripts/test.js. Broken links are removed or fixed, never silently left.
methodology.editorial: No ads, no affiliate links, no paid placement, no sponsored picks. Apps are listed because the free tier holds up, full stop. No personal data is collected by this site: it is static HTML with no analytics, no cookies, no accounts.

apps.name: Joplin
apps.summary: Open-source, offline-first notes with notebooks, tags, and optional end-to-end-free sync through Dropbox, OneDrive, WebDAV, or Joplin Cloud.
apps.freeTier: Unlimited notes and notebooks, markdown editing, attachments, tags, search, and sync with your own cloud storage (Dropbox, OneDrive, Nextcloud, WebDAV). No note limits, no device limits.
apps.limits: Joplin Cloud's own hosted sync (larger attachments, easier setup, publishing) is a paid extra, but you never need it to get full sync for free.
apps.paid: Optional: Joplin Cloud subscription for hosted sync. The app itself and self-managed sync are free forever.
apps.permissions: Storage/files access to manage note attachments; network for sync. It should not ask for contacts, location, or your camera.
apps.privacyNote: Notes stay on your device unless you configure sync. Open source (AGPL/communities) so behavior is auditable.

apps.name: Standard Notes
apps.summary: Encrypted notes app where the free tier already includes end-to-end encryption and unlimited plain notes across all your devices.
apps.freeTier: Unlimited notes on unlimited devices, end-to-end encryption, offline use, free syncing with a Standard Notes account.
apps.limits: Free tier uses the plain-text/markdown editor only. Rich markdown extensions, themes, and version history beyond 7 days are paid upgrades.
apps.paid: Product Features subscription adds extended editors and longer versioning. Notes themselves are never metered.
apps.permissions: Minimal: network for sync, storage for backups. No contacts or location.
apps.privacyNote: Private by default: encryption happens on-device before anything leaves your phone.

apps.name: Google Keep
apps.summary: Fast, colorful sticky notes, lists, and reminders that sync everywhere. The simple, everyone-already-has-it option.
apps.freeTier: Unlimited notes, checklists, photo notes, voice notes, reminders, and collaborative lists. Syncs free with your Google account and works on the web.
apps.limits: Not for long documents: notes are short-form by design. Partners with your Google account (so it is tied to Google).
apps.paid: Nothing. There is no paid Keep tier.
apps.permissions: Microphone for voice notes, camera for photo notes, storage for attachments, network. Location only if you add location reminders (optional; deny at will).
apps.privacyNote: Data lives on Googles servers per your account settings. Fine for shopping lists, not for secrets.

apps.name: Simplenote
apps.summary: Plain, fast notes that sync everywhere. No upsell screens, no locked features, no nagging. Exactly what it says on the tin.
apps.freeTier: Literally everything: unlimited notes, unlimited device sync, tagging, revisions, markdown, sharing, collaboration. Free with an Automattic account.
apps.limits: None that matter. No length or count limits on the free tier.
apps.paid: Nothing. Simplenote has no paid tier for personal use.
apps.permissions: Network for sync, storage for note backups. Minimal.
apps.privacyNote: Backed by Automattic (WordPress folks). Notes sync unencrypted-at-rest to their servers, but the app is open source and the privacy policy is genuinely plain-English.

apps.name: Obsidian
apps.summary: Local markdown notes with backlinks and a knowledge-graph view. Your notes are plain files you own.
apps.freeTier: The full mobile app: unlimited notes, backlinks, graph, community plugin support, sync via your own file storage (iCloud on iOS, sync adapters on Android). Free for personal use.
apps.limits: Obsidian Sync (their custodian service) is paid. Commercial use is technically not free, but personal use is and stays free.
apps.paid: Optional paid services: Obsidian Sync and Publish. The editor is free and offline.
apps.permissions: Storage/files access for your vault. No contacts, no location.
apps.privacyNote: Local-first: your vault is a folder of plain markdown files. The app does not phone home with your content.

apps.name: Microsoft OneNote
apps.summary: Free-form digital notebooks with sections, pages, and handwriting. The heavyweight note app, for free.
apps.freeTier: Full app with no feature lock: notebooks, sections, inking, audio notes, web clipper, sync across devices with a free Microsoft account.
apps.limits: Storage comes from OneDrive (5 GB free historically). No metered note limits.
apps.paid: Optional Microsoft 365 for extra OneDrive space and Office extras; not needed for OneNote itself.
apps.permissions: Microphone (audio notes), camera (scans/photos), storage, network.
apps.privacyNote: Tied to a Microsoft account and OneDrive. Local cache exists, but the source of truth is cloud.

apps.name: Google Drive's built-in scanner
apps.summary: A surprisingly capable scanner hiding inside the free Google Drive app: point your camera at paper, get a clean multi-page PDF.
apps.freeTier: Unlimited scans with edge detection and color modes, multi-page PDFs, and free storage in Drive. No watermark, no scan-count cap, no upsell, no ads.
apps.limits: Tied to your Google account (which most people already have). Scans consume shared Drive storage (15 GB free historically, plenty for PDFs).
apps.paid: Nothing for scanning. Only if you need more Drive storage overall does Google One enter the picture.
apps.permissions: Camera (to scan), storage (attachments), network (Drive sync).
apps.privacyNote: Scans land in your own Google Drive. No third party involved beyond Google itself, which you already implicitly use with that account.

apps.name: Adobe Scan
apps.summary: Clean automatic document scanning with free built-in OCR that makes PDFs searchable.
apps.freeTier: Unlimited scans, automatic edge detection and cleanup, OCR on scans, export to PDF. Free with an Adobe account.
apps.limits: Requires an Adobe account (free) before it will show scans. Deeper editing (rearranging, merging beyond basics, premium OCR) leans on a subscription.
apps.paid: Paid tier exists in Adobe ecosystem; core scanning + basic OCR stays free.
apps.ads: No ads inside the scanner itself.
apps.permissions: Camera, storage. Network for syncing to Adobe cloud.
apps.privacyNote: Scans sync to Adobe Document Cloud by default. You can turn off the automatic sync in settings, but this is the most cloud-bound scanner on this list.

apps.name: Genius Scan
apps.summary: Fast, accurate scanning with great batch mode. Free version is real and usable; paid tier mostly adds advanced exports.
apps.freeTier: Unlimited single-page scans, edge detection, auto-enhance, export as image or single PDF. Tagging and smart names included.
apps.limits: Free tier shows a watermark on exports for some features, and batch/multi-page plus OCR are part of Genius Scan Ultra / Pro upgrade.
apps.paid: One-time or subscription upgrade; not required to scan and share documents.
apps.ads: A few ads in the free tier; not intrusive at the scanning flow itself.
apps.permissions: Camera, storage. Optional network (for cloud export if you choose).
apps.privacyNote: Can run without any account; scans stay local unless you export.

apps.name: Insight Timer
apps.summary: Thousands of genuinely free meditations, sleep music tracks, soundscapes, and a beloved custom timer. The rare big-name app with a real free tier.
apps.freeTier: Thousands of free guided meditations, endless free music/sleep tracks, sleep meditations and ambient soundscapes, a customizable meditation timer, community groups, and stats. 100+ new free tracks added daily.
apps.limits: Paid courses (1,000+) and offline listening are behind the optional Premium subscription. The free library is not a trial and never expires.
apps.paid: Insight Premium subscription: courses, offline playback, advanced player. Optional.
apps.ads: No third-party ad network; occasional spots promoting Insight Timer's own courses.
apps.permissions: Network, notifications (session reminders), audio. No contacts or location.
apps.privacyNote: Optional account; listen without one for basic timer use. Data safety declaration on Play says data is encrypted in transit and deletable on request.

apps.name: Rain, Rain Sleep Sounds
apps.summary: Tons of high-quality rain, nature, and ambient loops you can mix into your own sleep soundscape.
apps.freeTier: 50+ HD sounds free with no playback-time limits, the full mixer, oscillator, soften controls, fade-out timer, and bedtime reminder. Wrote the book on decent free tiers.
apps.limits: Premium sounds (~60 more) are subscription-only; a small static banner ad sits at the bottom.
apps.paid: Rain Rain Premium subscription for extra sounds and an ad-free experience.
apps.ads: Small image banner in free tier; no audio/video ads.
apps.permissions: Audio, notifications (for alarm/timer). Storage in some versions for custom sound imports.
apps.privacyNote: Works offline once sounds are downloaded. No account required.

apps.name: White Noise Lite
apps.summary: Classic white/brown/pink noise plus ambient loops. The free 'Lite' edition is a real, working sound machine.
apps.freeTier: 40+ sounds in Lite, mixing, timer, alarm, background playing. Plain and straightforward.
apps.limits: Lite has a subset of the full catalog and shows ads. Paid full version unlocks the whole catalog and extras.
apps.paid: Paid White Noise (one-time style) removes ads and unlocks catalog.
apps.permissions: Audio, notifications, storage for custom sounds.
apps.privacyNote: Works offline; no account needed.

apps.name: Google Fit
apps.summary: Googles free activity tracker. Counts steps and Heart Points with no subscription attached.
apps.freeTier: Step counting, distance, active time, Heart Points goals, workout logging, and syncing with health platforms. No ads.
apps.limits: Tracks phone-sensor steps automatically; smartwatch depth depends on connected devices. No premium tier to bait you.
apps.paid: Nothing. Google Fit is free with no upsell inside.
apps.permissions: Activity recognition (steps), sensors, notifications. Location only if you map workouts (optional).
apps.privacyNote: Data is in your Google account. Manage at Google Privacy Dashboard.

apps.name: Samsung Health
apps.summary: Full-featured activity, sleep, and step tracker that ships on Samsung phones and is free on iPhone too.
apps.freeTier: Steps, sleep (on supported devices), activity logs, challenges, heart-rate trends where hardware allows. No subscription.
apps.limits: Some advanced features (body composition, ECG) only work on specific Samsung wearables.
apps.paid: Nothing for tracking. Samsung Health is free with no premium tier.
apps.permissions: Activity recognition, sensors, storage. Location optional for runs.
apps.privacyNote: Runs on-device plus Samsung cloud sync if you enable it. No third-party ad network involved.

apps.name: Pacer
apps.summary: Friendly pedometer that works off your phones sensors with simple history charts. Good free baseline.
apps.freeTier: Automatic step counting, daily goals, history, basic activity tracking, group challenges. Fully usable.
apps.limits: Premium adds deeper analytics, custom plans, and removes ads.
apps.paid: Pacer Premium subscription for advanced features.
apps.permissions: Activity recognition, sensors, optional location for walks, optional health-app integration.
apps.privacyNote: Account optional for casual counting; data not sold on free tier per policy.

apps.name: Goodbudget
apps.summary: Envelope budgeting done gently. The free tier is usable on its own.
apps.freeTier: An ad-free 'Free Forever' version: 10 regular envelopes plus 10 annual envelopes, envelope history, envelope budgeting across a couple of devices, and spending reports.
apps.limits: Free tier caps envelopes and history length. Premium unlocks unlimited envelopes, up to 5 devices, multi-year history, bank importing, and CSV exports.
apps.paid: Plus/Unlimited subscription tiers.
apps.ads: No ads at all in either tier.
apps.permissions: Network (sync), notifications. No contacts or location on free tier.
apps.privacyNote: Account required (envelope budgets sync); data sits on Goodbudgets cloud. Manual entry, no bank scraping on free tier.

apps.name: Money Manager
apps.summary: Straightforward double-entry bookkeeping app with instant charts. No account needed: data lives on your phone.
apps.freeTier: The real deal but ad-supported: unlimited transactions, budgets, categorization, instant stats/charts, and Excel backup/restore. Assets are capped at 15 on free, which is ample for personal use.
apps.limits: Ads on the free tier; over 15 assets, PC editing-view, and ad removal require the paid version.
apps.paid: A one-time paid version exists for ad removal and unlimited assets.
apps.permissions: Storage for backups. No account, no contacts, no location.
apps.privacyNote: Local-first: your ledger stays in the app unless you export a backup. A good pick if you are avoiding linked bank accounts.

apps.name: Your Spreadsheet, as a budget app
apps.summary: A plain, unglamorous truth: a simple spreadsheet you control beats any subscription budgeting app. Google Sheets is free and works fine on a phone.
apps.freeTier: Unlimited everything. You write the rules; nothing is metered, nothing is boxed in, and there is no reminder screen begging for upgrade.
apps.limits: It is your job to keep it going. Slightly more setup than an app, and formulas are yours to maintain.
apps.paid: Free with a Google account. A genuinely local, no-account alternative pairing is any markdown or CSV note in your favorite local notes app.
apps.permissions: Storage/files and network for sync, depending on the tool you pair it with.
apps.privacyNote: The most private option here if you keep the file local; Google Sheets lives on Googles servers per your account.

apps.name: Lichess
apps.summary: The gold standard. Free forever, open source, no ads, no paywall: unlimited puzzles and unlimited games.
apps.freeTier: Everything. Unlimited tactics puzzles, opening and endgame trainers, vs. computer, broadcast, analysis. The website runs on donations.
apps.limits: None. (Contrast: other chess sites paywall puzzles and lessons. Lichess does not.)
apps.paid: Lichess has no premium tier. Voluntary donations support the project.
apps.permissions: Network, notifications (for game invites). Minimal.
apps.privacyNote: Open source and auditable. No ads means no ad trackers.

apps.name: Chess.com
apps.summary: The biggest name in online chess with solid free play, plus lessons and bots.
apps.freeTier: Unlimited live games, bots, basic lessons, open Explorer access, and (as of recent checks) a limited number of free tactics puzzles/day. Community and content are great.
apps.limits: Puzzles, lessons, and game review are capped on free. Diamond/Premium opens those up.
apps.paid: Multiple subscription tiers.
apps.ads: Ads in free tier (banners, some interstitials).
apps.permissions: Network, notifications. Optional storage.
apps.privacyNote: Optional account; ads engine means ad-related tracking present on free tier.

apps.name: Chessable
apps.summary: Spaced-repetition chess study (move-by-move courses) with a genuinely large free course library.
apps.freeTier: Hundreds of courses are free, including popular 'Short & Sweet' opening introductions. Full MoveTrainer drills on free courses. A real study tool with no up-front cost.
apps.limits: Advanced/mega courses cost money; some features (deep variations) per-course. Mostly a course-grade paid add-on.
apps.paid: Per-course purchases and Pro subscription.
apps.ads: No ads inside the study experience.
apps.permissions: Network (course sync), notifications. Storage cache.
apps.privacyNote: Chess.com-affiliated; account required to save course progress.
